paragraphs: At the end of the cooking class, Chef Lucy gave the Explorers a recipe card for garlic soup. The card said, "Four heads of garlic, one small bottle of cream, and eight slices of bread." On Saturday, two pairs of friends went shopping for the next class. Each pair made one pot of soup.

Lily and Mia went to a store in the market. The store smelled of fresh bread. A woman stood behind the counter with a big smile. "We need four heads of garlic," said Lily. "The price is twenty baht," said the woman. "And we need one small bottle of cream," said Mia. "It is thirty-five baht," said the woman, and she showed the bottle clearly. "Do you have eight slices of bread?" asked Lily. "Yes, here you are," said the woman. Lily counted the slices twice. Mia paid for everything, and Lily put it all in a green bag.

Leo and May went to a store near the school. The store was quiet, and a small radio played soft music. A man sat behind the counter and read a book. "We need four heads of garlic, please," said May. "The price is twenty-four baht," said the man. "And we need one small bottle of cream," said Leo. "It is forty baht," said the man, and he gave Leo a bottle with a red top. "We want eight slices of bread," said May. "I will give you nine," said the man, "because the last one is very small." May paid for everything, and Leo carried the bag.

At the next class, the four friends met in the cooking room. They put the two bags on the table and looked at the recipe card. "We both bought four heads of garlic and one bottle of cream," said Lily. "But our prices are different," said May. "Your cream was cheaper than ours." "And you have nine slices of bread, and we have eight," said Mia. "The man gave us a small extra slice," said Leo. "I will eat it for lunch."

Chef Lucy came in and counted the bags. "Both pots have the right ingredients," she said. "The recipe is the same, and the soups will be good." Leo smiled and put the extra slice in his pocket. Mia laughed, and Lily wrote the price of everything in her notebook.
